en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Hadeed Bin Hakeym or Murazam who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whichever Believer brings an act of kindness to his brother, so he has brought it to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Darraj from Hadid ibn Hakim or Murazim who has said the following:

‘Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If a believing person maintains good relations with his brother in belief, he is considered as maintaining such relations with the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”
